honesty_note: Deterministic stand-in used to self-test the evaluation harness. These scores are NOT model performance and must not appear in the report's comparison table.

config.authorisation_note: Live calls require (1) team approval to transmit redacted complaint text to a third party, (2) this flag set to true, (3) LLM_API_KEY in the environment, and (4) an exact model version pinned in model_version. Until then only mock (harness self-test) and cache (replay) backends are used.
config.cost_policy: Hard stop when accumulated spend reaches budget_usd; token counts are logged per record in results/llm_costs.csv
